**Status:** CURRENT. Generated by `scripts/docs/build-task-board.py`; do not edit by hand.

**Audit record:** [codebase audit of commit `13407156`](auditsphere-execution-report-task-codebase-audit-current.json) (2026-10-08). Verdicts are static reading of the code; tests were not executed in that pass.

**How an agent uses this board:** find the ID in section 2, read its card (R2R and AUD in `docs/task_breakdown/tasks/`) or its story (STE in `docs/execution/`), take its open gaps from section 4, and respect its blockers. Do not mark a status from this board; record status only through the rules below.

**Completion rules (R2R and AUD cards):** `docs/task_breakdown/tools/task_status.py` validates and records status. A card becomes COMPLETED only with an independent APPROVED review, the full reviewed commit SHA, an evidence file, all six completion checklist items verified, and every dependency already COMPLETED. The helper refuses any other transition.

- Owner must decide on card step 3 and required output 8: either accept in writing the no-MediatR/no-bUnit variation (ledger section 2.3.1 of baseline reference) and rewrite the card, or approve a dependency under AGENTS.md section 5. No licence record exists.
- Section 5 targets Blazor (.Web); ADR-0002 says new screens are Angular only. Owner must reconcile or supersede.
- In-transaction authority re-check missing: RoleAdministrationService.RevokeRoleGrantAsync authorizes at :262, begins tx at :264, locks at :266, never re-checks. Not in ledger open items.
- In-transaction authority missing: ConsolidationService.AddMembershipAsync authorizes at Groups.cs:66 before tx at :71. Ledger defers to T041 but states no in-transaction check.
- ConsolidationService.ApproveScopeAsync (Scopes.cs:111-178) has no transaction; group revision read at :127-129 without row lock; unlocked save at :175-177. Ledger lists it only as T041 work.
- Owner decision still open: whether firm-role revocation revokes stored group grants. RevokeRoleGrantAsync has zero GroupAccessGrants references (ledger:19, :112).

- Architecture test enforcing one transaction owner per command (reference section 2.3) absent.
- Card checklist last item (independent reviewer accepted exact commit) unchecked; status IN_REVIEW.
